summary.text: Chad Puryear, a Republican, represents Arkansas House District 25, which includes portions of Washington, Crawford and Franklin counties, and is serving his second term.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's profile, his family has farmed the same land in Arkansas since 1887, and he now raises cattle and hay.

Puryear has more than twelve years of experience as a classroom teacher in public schools, and he received a B.S. in agriculture from the University of Arkansas and an M.S. in education from Arkansas State University.
